<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

<title>为了妹妹，我把心卖给了六个女人 · 海城契约引导</title>
<style>
:root {
  --page-width: 880px;
  --bg-dark: #0a1018;
  --bg-panel: #101a24;
  --bg-deep: #060b12;
  --bg-ink: #0d1620;
  --line: #2a3a4d;
  --line-soft: #1d2c3a;
  --gold: #b6aa78;
  --gold-bright: #e2d5a1;
  --gold-dim: #796e4e;
  --red: #a65b6d;
  --red-bright: #d67789;
  --neon-blue: #6fc9ff;
  --neon-pink: #ff7ab8;
  --neon-violet: #a58aff;
  --text: #d9d5e7;
  --text-dim: #9a94b0;
  --mc: #6fe0b0;
  --lin: #86b8ff;
  --gu: #ff8a6a;
  --su: #d6a5ff;
  --an: #ffc26a;
  --ye: #ff9eb0;
  --wen: #f2b8e0;
  --xia: #ddd08a;
}

* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: "Noto Serif SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "PingFang SC", "Georgia", serif;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

body {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  position: relative;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -30%, rgba(111, 201, 255, .10), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 30%, rgba(165, 138, 255, .10), transparent 32%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 25%, rgba(255, 122, 184, .08), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 120%, rgba(60, 90, 130, .20), transparent 45%);
}

/* ===== 背景：雨丝 ===== */
.rain-layer {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rain-layer i {
  position: absolute;
  top: -20vh;
  width: 1px;
  height: 60px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(180, 200, 220, .45), transparent);
  animation: rainFall linear infinite;
  opacity: .5;
}

.rain-layer i.heavy {
  height: 100px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(220, 235, 255, .65), transparent);
}

@keyframes rainFall {
  0% { transform: translateY(-10vh) translateX(0); }
  100% { transform: translateY(120vh) translateX(-30px); }
}

/* ===== 背景：玻璃水汽 ===== */
.fog-layer {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.025), transparent 22%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%, rgba(255,255,255,.020), transparent 25%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 40% 80%, rgba(255,255,255,.018), transparent 20%);
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
}

/* ===== 主容器 ===== */
.guide {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--page-width);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  animation: bookEnter 1.5s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.2,1) both;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  perspective: 1400px;
}

@keyframes bookEnter {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(70px) scale(.85);
    filter: blur(20px) brightness(1.4) saturate(1.6);
  }
  45% {
    opacity: 1;
    filter: blur(6px) brightness(1.15) saturate(1.15);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    filter: blur(0) brightness(1) saturate(1);
  }
}

/* ===== 顶部导航 ===== */
.nav-top {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.nav-dot {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(111, 201, 255, .03), rgba(0,0,0,.1));
  color: var(--text-dim);
  min-width: 50px;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  transition: all .3s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.2,1);
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

.nav-dot:hover {
  color: var(--neon-blue);
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(111, 201, 255, .35), inset 0 0 12px rgba(111, 201, 255, .1);
  text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(111, 201, 255, .6);
}

.nav-dot.active {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(111, 201, 255, .28), rgba(165, 138, 255, .18));
  color: #eaf8ff;
  border-color: var(--neon-blue);
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 22px rgba(111, 201, 255, .55),
    inset 0 0 14px rgba(111, 201, 255, .25);
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, .6);
  animation: neonBreath 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes neonBreath {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(111, 201, 255, .45), inset 0 0 12px rgba(111, 201, 255, .2); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(111, 201, 255, .75), inset 0 0 16px rgba(111, 201, 255, .35); }
}

/* ===== 页面容器 ===== */
.page {
  display: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(30, 45, 65, .55), rgba(10, 16, 24, .85)),
    var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 46px);
  position: relative;
  min-height: 560px;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, .85),
    0 0 40px rgba(60, 100, 150, .12),
    inset 0 0 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  overflow: hidden;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  left: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 200%;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 40%, rgba(180, 210, 240, .06) 50%, transparent 60%);
  transform: skewX(-18deg);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.page::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(111, 201, 255, .08);
  border-radius: 16px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;

.page > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

.page.active {
  display: block;
  animation: pageIn 1s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.2,1) both;
}

@keyframes pageIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: perspective(1400px) rotateY(18deg) translateX(120px);
    transform-origin: right center;
    filter: blur(8px) brightness(1.3);
  }
  55% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: perspective(1400px) rotateY(-3deg) translateX(-10px);
    transform-origin: right center;
    filter: blur(2px) brightness(1.1);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: perspective(1400px) rotateY(0deg) translateX(0);
    filter: blur(0) brightness(1);
  }
}

h1, h2, h3 {
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--gold-bright);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

h1 {

h2 {

h2::after {

p, .text { color: var(--text); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.95; }
.text-dim { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 14px; }
.center { text-align: center; }

button {

  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 12px 28px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-dim);

.btns { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; margin-top: 28px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.cover-icon::before {

.char-card {

.char-card::before {

.char-pic img {

@keyframes avatarGlow {

.persona-btn {

  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all .3s;

.persona-btn:hover {

.info-item {

  font-size: 14px;

  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(226, 213, 161, .2);

.form input, .form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--bg-deep);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
